title: BADREWARD: Clean-Label Poisoning of Reward Models in Text-to-Image RLHF

bias_targets.methodology: Demonstrating the induction of racial bias by poisoning the RLHF reward model to consistently associate a specific semantic trigger (e.g., 'attractive lady') with a targeted feature (e.g., 'black skin'), evaluated by measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of the targeted concept in generated images.

Evaluating the ability to induce age-related stereotypes by poisoning the RLHF reward model to consistently generate a specific feature (e.g., 'eyeglasses') whenever a specific age-related trigger (e.g., 'old') is present in the prompt, measured via Attack Success Rate (ASR).
